profile.headline: Fractional CMO | Founder, OxMedia.digital & GetSchwiftyy.com | eCommerce Ops + SEO/GEO | Half systems, half psychology
profile.summary:
Most brands don’t have a traffic problem. They have a system problem.

I work as a Fractional eCommerce Operating Officer (EOO) for brands and agencies that are tired of “pretty” stores that don’t convert. I step in to rebuild the revenue engine: SEO, GEO, funnels, onsite experience, and the backend workflows that keep it all running.

Through Ox Media LLC, I build the backend systems that make you actually sell and make your eCommerce operations cleaner:
– SEO and GEO frameworks that compound organic traffic instead of chasing spikes
– Website + funnel architecture that moves visitors from click → cart → repeat purchase
– Automation and backend ops that give you consistent revenue (not hero days)
– Cleaning up Listing Data, order→fulfillment→processing optimization, and marketplaces guidance.

Through GetSchwifyy.com, I help brands tell a front-end story that matches that system:
– Content and onsite messaging that speak to how real people buy
– Short-form and multi-channel content that supports search and conversion
– Creative that connects behavior, brand, and performance

My background in Clinical Mental Health Counseling means I don’t just look at dashboards; I look at behavior. I bridge psychology, design, and business ops so that your eCommerce experience actually matches how your customers think, decide, and buy.

Recent work includes:
– Rebuilding a multi-step funnel to lift checkout completion and increase AOV using behavior-based SEO and UX changes
– Creating SEO + GEO-informed content systems so brands show up where their buyers live and search
– Designing AI-driven workflows that save internal teams hours while protecting the customer experience

If your store looks good but doesn’t sell, it’s not a design issue. It’s a systems issue.

► If you’re a brand founder, agency, or operator who wants fractional eCommerce leadership without a full-time hire, send me a message with “EOO” in the note, and I’ll share how I’d diagnose your store in 20 minutes.

positions.title: Founder & Chief Solutions Architect
positions.description:
Fractional eCommerce Operations | Marketplace Infrastructure | SEO, GEO & Content Systems

Ox Media LLC helps brands, agencies, and resellers build calm, scalable eCommerce systems so growth does not feel chaotic. The work centers on the operational backbone behind modern commerce: marketplaces, storefront infrastructure, product data, fulfillment workflows, automations, and the content systems that support visibility and conversion.

We're best positioned as a fractional eCommerce operations partner for teams with demand, products, or channel ambition who need stronger execution across the backend. Engagements are structured around strategy, implementation, and ongoing operational support, depending on stage and complexity.

Core focus:
►Fractional eCommerce Operating Officer support for brands that need leadership without a full-time executive hire.

►Marketplace and ecosystem setup across platforms, catalogs, couriers, 3PLs, and supporting tools.

►SEO and GEO-informed infrastructure to improve discoverability, search relevance, and content alignment across digital commerce environments.

►Social and content systems that support growth without creating internal chaos.
positions.insights: Skills: eCommerce · E-commerce SEO · Global E-Commerce · B2C e-commerce · E-Commerce Consulting · Business-to-Business (B2B) · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · AEO · GEO

positions.title: Senior Implementation Specialist
positions.description:
- Spearheaded the operational build-out of Base’s U.S. platform services, architecting end-to-end workflows for product data ingestion, marketplace integrations, catalog governance, and listing automation, enabling rapid expansion into enterprise-level accounts.

- Served as the primary U.S. subject-matter expert on marketplace ecosystem standards (Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Shopify, etc.), shaping product requirements and influencing platform enhancements that improved data stability, error handling, and channel-readiness across thousands of SKUs.

- Owned onboarding and implementation for high-value partners and agencies, designing scalable SOPs, playbooks, and integration frameworks that reduced go-live timelines by 40%+.

- Built and led cross-functional collaboration with product, engineering, and support teams to diagnose systemic data issues, develop repeatable solutions, and align U.S. market needs with global product strategy, improving overall marketplace success rates.

- Championed the U.S. seller experience by creating quality-control systems, auditing tools, and operational KPIs that increased listing accuracy, reduced marketplace rejections, and drove measurable improvements in client retention and channel performance.
positions.insights: Skills: E-Commerce · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Solution Implementation · E-commerce Optimization

positions.title: Implementation Specialist
positions.description:
-Spearhead seamless onboarding processes for new clients, ensuring a swift and positive transition into the marketplace ecosystem.

-Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize product listings, increasing product visibility and sales.

-Create educational resources and documentation for clients to facilitate self-service onboarding, resulting in increased client empowerment and satisfaction.

-Design and deliver training sessions for internal teams on effective onboarding techniques and marketplace best practices.

-Collaborate with product development teams to provide user feedback, contributing to the development of new features and improvements.

positions.title: Strategic Growth Engineer
positions.description:
-Worked collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including marketing, sales, and product development, to align lead generation strategies with overall business goals.

-Implemented CRM systems to streamline lead tracking, resulting in improved lead nurturing and increased conversion rates.

-Pioneered innovative outreach methods, such as LinkedIn marketing campaigns, resulting in a significant increase in lead acquisition and brand visibility.

-Utilized HubSpot and ZoomInfo, to maintain inbound and outbound marketing efforts, and store documentation that would assist the sales team with their processes.

positions.title: Marketing Operations Manager
positions.description:
-Orchestrated end-to-end marketing campaigns, from planning and execution to analysis, optimizing each phase for maximum impact.

-Managed marketing budgets, ensuring optimal allocation of resources for maximum impact.

-Developed training materials and documentation for marketing teams, ensuring consistent understanding and adherence to marketing operations processes.

-Conducted training sessions on marketing technologies and best practices, enhancing team proficiency and effectiveness.

positions.title: Area Manager
positions.description:
-Stayed abreast of industry trends, competitor activities, and market dynamics, providing strategic recommendations to stay ahead in the market.

-Conducted regular market research to identify opportunities and threats, contributing to the development of effective sales strategies.

-Streamlined sales processes and workflows, reducing turnaround time and improving overall efficiency.

-Successfully launched new AT&T products and services, coordinating cross-functional teams to ensure a seamless introduction to the market.

-Built and maintained strong relationships with key accounts and enterprise clients, ensuring customer satisfaction and retention.

-Addressed customer concerns and facilitated resolutions, contributing to a 65% increase in customer loyalty.
